headline: 'Superhuman' AI Tool Spots Heart Disease in Under 2 Seconds
meta_description: A breakthrough AI tool can now identify heart disease in less than 2 seconds, offering hope for faster diagnosis and earlier intervention.
summary_short: Researchers have developed an AI tool that detects heart disease in under 2 seconds—faster and more reliably than traditional methods.
body:
An artificial intelligence tool has been developed that can identify heart disease in less than 2 seconds, marking a significant leap forward in cardiac diagnostics. The speed and accuracy of this technology have earned it the description 'superhuman' among researchers tracking its performance.

The breakthrough represents a shift in how medical professionals might approach heart disease screening in the future. By dramatically reducing the time needed for detection, the tool could enable earlier intervention and potentially save lives through faster diagnosis and treatment planning.

This development emerged from discussion on r/UpliftingNews, where the medical innovation caught the attention of the community. The tool's ability to work at such speed opens possibilities for wider accessibility and more efficient use of healthcare resources.
quick_facts: AI detects heart disease in under 2 seconds
